title: MHADA outside Pune: the Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar lottery is open until 23 October (97 flats in the 20% scheme from 10.82 lakh); Nashik, Nagpur and Amravati are not open now
audience: Marathi families outside Pune (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Waluj, Nashik, Nagpur, Wardha, Amravati) who saw our MHADA Pune reels and asked about their district, 22-50
message: On MHADA's lottery portal the live boards are Pune and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: Sambhajinagar's lottery is open until 23 October, with 97 flats in the 20 percent scheme from 10.82 lakh; Waluj comes under the Sambhajinagar board; Nashik, Nagpur (Wardha) and Amravati have no lottery open now; the Pune lottery is only for Pune, PCMC and PMRDA, until 22 October.
facts: MHADA's lottery portal (housing.mhada.gov.in, View Live Schemes, read 18 October 2026) lists live lotteries for the Pune board and the Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar board only (and MHADA CDP).

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar board, application and payment from 28 August to 23 October 2026: CSNB_02 20 percent scheme with 97 flats in 5 schemes, 10.82 to 17.98 lakh (Bramha Park in Satara, Param Suvarn Vastu in Itkheda, Trilok Heights in Shahanurwadi, Tuljai Park in Nakshatrawadi). Source: MHADA lottery portal, 18 October 2026.

The same board's CSNB_01 MHADA scheme has 73 MIG plots in Murtijapur (31.13 to 65.36 lakh) and 2 row houses; CSNB_03 OMR scheme has 32 EWS plots in Nilanga, Latur (2.33 lakh). Source: MHADA lottery portal, 18 October 2026.
Waluj comes under the Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar board; Wardha under the Nagpur board.
No lottery of the Nashik, Nagpur or Amravati boards was live on MHADA's portal on 18 October 2026; Nashik's July 2026 lottery result is already published.
The MHADA Pune lottery's homes are only in Pune city, Pimpri-Chinchwad and PMRDA; its last date is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; MHADA has appointed no agent.

caption:
MHADA Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Lottery 2026 | म्हाडा: संभाजीनगर लॉटरी सुरू, नाशिक-नागपूरचे काय?

आमच्या MHADA पुणे व्हिडिओवर अनेकांनी विचारलं: वाळूज, संभाजीनगर, नाशिक, वर्धामध्ये घरं आहेत का? MHADA च्या लॉटरी पोर्टलवर (18 ऑक्टोबरला पाहिलेलं):

✅ छत्रपती संभाजीनगर मंडळ: लॉटरी सुरू, अर्ज आणि पेमेंट 23 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत
  • 20% योजना: 97 फ्लॅट, ₹10.82-17.98 लाख (ब्रह्मा पार्क-सातारा, परम सुवर्ण वास्तू-इटखेडा, त्रिलोक हाइट्स-शहानूरवाडी, तुळजाई पार्क-नक्षत्रवाडी)
  • MHADA योजना: मुर्तिजापूर येथे 73 MIG प्लॉट (₹31.13-65.36 लाख) आणि 2 रो-हाउस
  • OMR योजना: निलंगा, लातूर येथे 32 EWS प्लॉट (₹2.33 लाख)
🗺️ वाळूज: संभाजीनगर मंडळ · वर्धा: नागपूर मंडळ
⏸️ नाशिक, नागपूर, अमरावती: सध्या लॉटरी सुरू नाही (नाशिकचा जुलैचा निकाल आधीच जाहीर)
📍 पुणे लॉटरी: फक्त पुणे, PCMC, PMRDA साठी, 22 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत

🔔 तुमच्या मंडळाची लॉटरी जाहीर झाली की आम्ही पोस्ट करू. फॉलो करा आणि तुमचा जिल्हा कमेंटमध्ये लिहा.

🌐 अधिकृत साइट: https://housing.mhada.gov.in/ (View Live Schemes)
⚠️ MHADA ने कोणताही एजंट नेमलेला नाही. अर्जासाठी कोणालाही पैसे देऊ नका.

reply_faq.q: Is there a MHADA lottery in Sambhajinagar, Aurangabad or Waluj now?
reply_faq.a: Yes. The Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar board's lottery is open on MHADA's portal until 23 October 2026: 97 flats in the 20 percent scheme (10.82 to 17.98 lakh), 73 MIG plots in Murtijapur and 2 row houses, and 32 EWS plots in Nilanga, Latur. Waluj comes under this board.

reply_faq.q: Is there a MHADA lottery in Nashik, Nagpur, Wardha or Amravati now?
reply_faq.a: Not as of 18 October 2026: MHADA's portal shows live lotteries only for the Pune and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar boards. Wardha comes under the Nagpur board. We will post when your board announces one.

reply_faq.q: Can someone from another district apply in the Pune or Sambhajinagar lottery?
reply_faq.a: Anyone with a Maharashtra domicile certificate who meets the income limit can apply, but the homes are where the lottery is: the Pune lottery in Pune, PCMC and PMRDA, the Sambhajinagar lottery in its region.
